prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
[goal] June incident report: window, duration, availability vs 99.9% SLO, root cause, saved to ./result.json.

[action] Read ./logs (3 daily logs + README). Grepped all ERROR/WARN/crash/restart/ready lines across files; read the full incident region of gameserver-2026-06-02.log (lines 241-294). Computed downtime and availability with PowerShell from the exact timestamps; validated result.json parses.

[result] Written to `./result.json` (verified valid JSON):
- start: 2026-06-02T03:17:42 (first `SaveGame failed ... No space left on device`)
- end: 2026-06-02T03:53:31 (`server ready, accepting players`)
- minutes_down: 35.82 (exactly 2149 s = 35.8167 min)
- availability_june_pct: 99.92 (exact 99.9171; (43200 − 35.8167)/43200)
- slo_999_ok: true (99.9171 ≥ 99.9)
- root_cause: /data disk filled (97% used at 03:10:02) from unrotated backups; saves failed with ENOSPC, watchdog crash-looped the server (exit 137) until backup rotation freed 38.2 GB at 03:52:10; ready at 03:53:31.

Why it is right: the README defines down = first save error to 'server ready' and states June has 30 days with exactly one incident. Those two lines exist only once in all logs (June 2 lines 251 and 294); the only other error in June is a single unrelated RCON bad-password attempt (June 1, 09:12:40). Math re-computed and quoted above from the shell output (`secs=2149 ... avail=99.9170910493827 slo_ok=True`).

Assumptions I chose: the README is the team's notes; the 97% disk warning at 03:10:02 is a precursor, not the outage start (README says start at the first save error); availability is measured over calendar June (43200 min) with all non-incident time counted up; timestamps are server-local; minutes_down and availability rounded to 2 decimals.

[next] None. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.
